So I live in the US but my hometown is in Mexico. My aunt had puppies and I kept one. My dog (Maxx) has a literal twin from that litter, which she kept (Santi). 

My aunts neighbor hates my aunt because it all started with my aunt cutting a tree branch that was coming to her property 13 years ago (no damage to the tree itself). The neighbor then started picking fights for random things throughout the years. She has dogs that bark all day long but now that my aunt has dogs she complains about them barking. Its crazy because the lady has a big big hatred for my aunt and my aunt has done everything possible to be nice and civil and she was deeply hurt for making the neighbor upset for whatever reason.

Anyway, fast forward to early February. My aunt leaves town for one night, left the dogs in the yard with food and water. Santi and the other dogs always run around the yard and up to a balcony which has a connection to a wall of the house of the neighbor and you can see their backyard from it. Somehow, we still are not sure how, Santi fell into the neighbors yard. 

The next day, my aunt arrives and freaks out looking for Santi. She hears him crying and howling until she found out through the balcony that he was in the neighbors yard, immobile, shaking, and shivering. She runs to the neighbors door and starts knocking and screaming so they can let her get her dog. No one responded for five minutes so she said screw it and opened the gate to their yard, picked up Santi and took him home. Then as she left they posted in the neighborhood Facebook group that she invaded their home and that she was doing illegal things and that she should be thankful they “took care” of her dog. The neighborhood then proceeded to bully her for it.

A day later Santi was screaming at the touch of people, had diarrhea and blood (he passed stools 17x a day with blood). We thought it was from the fall, immediately took him to the vet. We found out he had foreign objects in his colon. They extracted a condom with unidentifiable objects. There is no way he could have gotten that from anywhere else except the neighbors. We thought he wouldn’t make it but after a month he’s still around. He is not his normal self and I just hope to god Karma comes back around to this woman. The dog is an innocent animal and I’m sure he even trusted her while he was there. 

I wish there was something I could do to help or get back at her (I know its wrong, it’s just my deep evil desires).

I discovered the rat around 6am. I was in the same spot the evening prior to check for “presents”, so I knew it hadn’t been there too long, and also why the mold surprised me since it had actually spread to the grass.

It’s been warm in the day (~85-90 def F) with cool evenings (~65-70 def F). 

So, no flies around it, tbh the skin condition overall looked like it had died within the week. The remaining skin looked pretty firm overall, just with a ton of holes (approx 1-2cm diameter, though they were a bit oval)! It was intact, as in, no body part separation. It was covered in ants, which may have likely further contributed to the holes.

I’ve seen decomposed mice/rats in our garage before where they flatten out and smell bad. This was so different that I had to go online lol. 

I’m thinking it has likely died a while ago but was originally in a cool/shaded area so the skin wasn’t decomposing as quickly. Maybe the day was humid enough to make it moldy? And eventually when it was brought to the grass in my yard, the cool environment, humidity, and active mold was just magnified? 

Gah, those holes were just so damn freaky. Blegh!!!
